name: @akua-dev/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for akua — render Kubernetes Packages in-process. Helm + Kustomize engines, OCI fetch, cosign verify, JSON Schema export. No `akua` binary required.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/mod.ts src/execute.ts --target node --format esm --outdir dist --sourcemap=linked --packages=external && bunx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && bun run scripts/verify-package-exports.ts
